sentence: This project builds a screening tool that reports how drugs aimed at ion channels change the electrical properties and growth of cancer stem cells.
This project builds ultrasound imaging that tracks bubbles to monitor histotripsy ablation of renal tumors and tests it in animal tissue.
This project studies how cocaine changes the activity of circuits in the striatum and how that drives cocaine seeking.
This project studies how cancer centers can improve the steps for running cancer prevention trials in people at high risk.
This project designs drug delivery systems that carry mRNA to specific cells and tests them in animal studies.
This project builds a urine test that checks whether bladder cancer has come back.
This project builds tools that study the many different forms of proteins that underlie health and disease.
This project studies the makeup of glutamate receptors in the cochlea so drugs can target them to prevent hearing loss from noise trauma.
This project studies how herpes simplex viruses enter the cells they infect.
This project studies how cells in a nematode embryo divide and become different cell types, using microscopy and genomics tools.
This project builds a test that uses RNA hybridization to detect antibiotic resistance in tuberculosis bacteria.
This project studies how mitochondrial energy production affects the liver, using an animal model that deletes a gene needed for it.
This project studies how a fusion oncoprotein forms condensates in cells and how they relate to pediatric cancers.
This project studies how metabolism lets some hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells dominate the blood system in older people.
This project studies emerging viruses, including tick-borne viruses and respiratory viruses, to understand the threat they pose.
This project studies how social media about e-cigarette products relates to their use among Mexican American young adults.
This project studies how bacteria that cause serious infections become resistant to current drugs and drugs in late-stage development.
This project uses wearable sensors and deep brain stimulation electrodes to study the brain pathways behind balance problems in Parkinson’s disease.
This project uses super-resolution imaging to study the three-dimensional organization of transcriptional condensates and enhancers that control gene expression.
This project tries to find out how a poorly understood process disrupts pancreatic beta cells that produce insulin in type 2 diabetes.
